parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest a suitable reagent for the formation of $[\text{CoCl}_4]^{2-}$ from solution **A**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
The complex ion $[\text{CoCl}_4]^{2-}$ has tetrahedral geometry.

The 3d orbitals in an isolated $\text{Co}^{2+}$ ion are degenerate.

parts.label: (b)(ii)

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
$\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ can act as an oxidising agent or a reducing agent when reacting with species that contain manganese.

Table 2.2 shows electrode potentials, $E^\ominus$, for some electrode reactions.

Table 2.2

| electrode reaction | $E^\ominus / \text{V}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $\text{MnO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{Mn(OH)}_2 + 2\text{OH}^-$ | -0.04 |
| $\text{MnO}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{Mn}^{2+} + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$ | +1.22 |
| $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2 + 2\text{H}^+ + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$ | +1.78 |
| $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2 + \text{OH}^- + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons 3\text{OH}^-$ | +0.88 |
| $\text{O}_2 + 2\text{H}^+ + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ | +0.68 |

Use **only** the species listed in Table 2.2 to suggest:
- one reaction in which $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ acts as an oxidising agent and
- one reaction in which $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ acts as a reducing agent.

Include the value of the standard cell potential, $E^\ominus_{\text{cell}}$, and an overall equation for each reaction.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
Acidified manganate(VII) ions, $\text{MnO}_4^-$, can be used to analyse the content of iron tablets by titration.

**Two** identical iron tablets are crushed and dissolved in distilled water.

The resulting solution is made up to $150.0\text{ cm}^3$ with distilled water.

$25.0\text{ cm}^3$ of this solution requires $18.60\text{ cm}^3$ of $0.0500\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ acidified $\text{MnO}_4^-$ to reach the end-point. All the $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ ions are oxidised.

The relevant half-equations are shown.

$$\text{MnO}_4^- + 8\text{H}^+ + 5\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{Mn}^{2+} + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

$$\text{Fe}^{2+} \rightleftharpoons \text{Fe}^{3+} + \text{e}^-$$
parts.text: Describe the colour change observed at the end-point of this titration.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Calculate the mass, in mg, of iron in **one** tablet.

Assume that all the iron in the tablets is $\text{Fe}^{2+}$.

Show your working.
